dataTool('fields.list','Discover partial common native fields: name and visible only; exact owner hash, authoring values, no Atomic internals.',required(obj({owner:dataOwner}),'owner'),true,a=>({owner:a.owner,fields:Object.keys(FrameFields.specs).map(field=>FrameFields.read(a.owner,field))}));

function bounded(value){let count=0;const visit=v=>{if(++count>limits.values)FrameAuthorData.error('Field response exceeds value budget','LIMIT_EXCEEDED');if(v&&typeof v==='object')for(const x of Object.values(v))visit(x);};visit(value);if(new TextEncoder().encode(JSON.stringify(value)).byteLength>limits.bytes)FrameAuthorData.error('Field response exceeds byte budget','LIMIT_EXCEEDED');return value;}
patches.after: function bounded(value){let count=0,bytes=0;const encoder=new TextEncoder(),charge=n=>{bytes+=n;if(bytes>limits.bytes)FrameAuthorData.error('Field response exceeds byte budget','LIMIT_EXCEEDED');},visit=v=>{if(++count>limits.values)FrameAuthorData.error('Field response exceeds value budget','LIMIT_EXCEEDED');if(v&&typeof v==='object'){charge(2);for(const [key,x]of Object.entries(v)){charge(Array.isArray(v)?1:encoder.encode(JSON.stringify(key)).byteLength+2);visit(x);}}else charge(encoder.encode(JSON.stringify(v)).byteLength);};visit(value);if(encoder.encode(JSON.stringify(value)).byteLength>limits.bytes)FrameAuthorData.error('Field response exceeds byte budget','LIMIT_EXCEEDED');return value;}

patches.before: Validate all exact native field writes before one native Undo transaction.
patches.after: Write only name/visible metadata; validate every target before one native Undo transaction. Parameters are read-only through this adapter.

patches.before: Calls are serialized and resolve after GPU/editor work.
patches.after: Calls are serialized; ordinary commands settle GPU/editor work, while authorData and fields data-only reads observe current metadata without settlement.
